# Solihull Council, "How Reception Places Were Offered" (the shape
# fetch_solihull's own docstring describes): three years side by side,
# most recent first, each year a pair of columns so the distances land
# at indices 2, 4 and 6. "All offered" and "N/A" mean the school was not
# oversubscribed that year.
#
# The years sit in a row of their own above the "School" row, which is
# how the PDF extracts (checked against the live file, 20 Sep 2026).
#
# Cells are separated by "|"; lines starting with "#" are not part of
# the table.
